description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Hydro-centrelines connect streams, rivers, waterbodies, culverts, pipes and subterranean features, with NPDES stream type and spatial-source fields. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including FeatureName, FeatureType, SpatialSource, Label, created_user, created_date. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for network flow studies. Geometry combines 2011 LiDAR, orthophotography, contours and GPS drainage inventory. Accuracy varies by source; the provider notes lower-quality DNR data near Mount Rainier. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
